items.title: Orkla Snacks Acquires The European Candy Group
items.summary: Orkla Snacks is to acquire European Candy Group for €207m, boosting production capacity for its fast-growing BUBS brand.

items.title: Tedi acquires Polish Woolworth stores
items.summary: The German discount chain TEDi is acquiring 76 stores in Poland from its sister company Woolworth, which is exiting the Polish market. Both non-food discounters have ambitions for European growth.

items.title: Global Eggs strikes Germany M&A through Hevo arm
items.summary: Hevo Group, the Spanish egg supplier backed by Brazil’s Global Eggs, has announced an acquisition in Germany. The post Global Eggs strikes Germany M&A through Hevo arm appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: DIA Spain Reports Double-Digit Sales Growth In H1
items.summary: Spanish supermarket operator DIA reported an 11.6% growth in gross sales in the first half of its 2026 financial year to €2.95 billion.

items.title: Hevo Group Expands European Footprint With Müritz Acquisition
items.summary: Spanish poultry producer Hevo Group has acquired German egg producer Müritz, which is based roughly 150 kilometres from Berlin.

items.title: Takeover of Boots drugstore chain in jeopardy
items.summary: Sycamore Partners, the owner of the British drugstore chain Boots, has rejected an offer from the Weston billionaire family after another potential buyer withdrew. Uncertainty about the retailer's future persists.

items.title: Canada's Loblaw Posts 4.1% Growth In Q2 Revenue
items.summary: Canada's Loblaw Companies Limited reported revenue growth of 4.1% year-on-year to $15.3 billion (€9.4 billion) in the second quarter.

items.title: The number of complaints about fraudulent online stores continues to rise in Belgium
items.summary: The number of scams involving fake online stores continues to rise in Belgium. Last year, the Federal Public Service for the Economy recorded an average of 23 complaints from victims every day.

items.title: Great Northern Distillery strikes deal to supply Tsingtao with whiskey
items.summary: Ireland's Great Northern Distillery is to supply Tsingtao with a range of Irish whiskeys as the Chinese brewer embarks on setting up its own distillery.

items.title: Henkell Freixenet sells UK wine merchant Jascots
items.summary: Henkell Freixenet has offloaded UK wine merchant Jascots to Italian food-and-drinks group Compagnia del Gusto Holding.

items.title: Ebro Foods Profits Rise 7.1% In H1 Despite Revenue Headwinds
items.summary: Spanish food company Ebro Foods posted a 7.1% increase in net profit, to €103.9 million, in the first half of its 2025 year.

items.title: Dutch Online Supermarket Crisp Secures €25m For Expansion
items.summary: Dutch online supermarket app Crisp has raised €25 million in a new investment round, to scale up and grow the company.

items.title: Waterdrop continues Belgian expansion in Woluwe
items.summary: The Austrian sustainable beverage brand Waterdrop is opening its eighth Belgian location at the Woluwe Shopping Center. Belgium is one of the company’s strongest and most promising markets.

items.title: Jobs at risk across Diageo’s distilleries in Scotland
items.summary: Hundreds of jobs have been put at risk of redundancy across Diageo's distilleries in the Scottish Highlands and Islands, a local trade union has said.

items.title: Decathlon considers selling Van Rysel bikes at other retailers
items.summary: With its premium bicycle brand Van Rysel, Decathlon aims to become the European leader. In addition to its own flagship stores and the bicycle departments within its large Decathlon stores, the company is also considering partnerships with other retailers.

items.title: German Consumer Sentiment Falls In August After Brief Recovery - HDE
items.summary: Consumer sentiment in Germany declined in August as renewed tensions in the Middle East clouded consumer sentiment, HDE said.

items.title: El Corte Inglés accelerates international growth of its subsidiary chain, Sfera
items.summary: Sfera, the fashion chain owned by the Spanish department store group El Corte Inglés, opened 28 stores outside Spain last year, expanding the chain’s international retail network from 346 to 367 locations, primarily through franchising.

items.title: Sainsbury’s Offers Nectar Points On Uber Eats Grocery Orders
items.summary: UK retailer Sainsbury’s has announced that it is now offering Nectar points to customers ordering grocery deliveries via Uber Eats.

items.title: [In the picture] Colruyt and IKEA throwing raves as a marketing stunt
items.summary: Last weekend, two completely legal rave parties took place at IKEA and Colruyt stores in Belgium. For both retailers, this was an opportunity to appeal to a younger audience.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium Implements Heatwave Plan To Manage Demand Spikes
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium adjusts deliveries, expands beverage storage and strengthens cold-chain checks under its new heatwave response plan.

items.title: Lidl Appoints Spanish Executive To Global Real Estate Role
items.summary: Imanol Zabala, general manager of expansion and real estate at Lidl Spain, will step in as Lidl's International director of real estate.q

items.title: Over Half A Million Clubcard Members Have £100 In Unused Vouchers, Tesco Says
items.summary: Tesco is encouraging Clubcard members to use their unspent vouchers, as more than half a million users have over £100 in unused rewards.

items.title: Colruyt Professionals opens its eighth location
items.summary: Colruyt Group continues to invest in its business-to-business operations: on August 5, the eighth Colruyt Professionals location will open in Alleur; this retail format focuses exclusively on professional customers.

items.title: AI is becoming the co-agent for food scientists

items.title: How beverage manufacturers are turning water reuse into a growth strategy
items.summary: Water reuse is no longer just a sustainability initiative. For beverage manufacturers, it's a strategic investment driving growth and resilience.

items.summary: Seafood giant Thai Union has lifted its forecasts for annual sales and gross profits. The post Thai Union ups forecasts after “strong” Q2 appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Bol will provide its sales partners with more data and analytics
items.summary: At the request of the Dutch regulatory authority, Bol, Ahold Delhaize’s online store, has implemented several improvements to increase transparency for both consumers and business partners.

items.title: Hershey pricing hits confectionery volumes as salty snacks respond to cuts
items.summary: Hershey is confident it can restore confectionery volumes lost to price as optimism emerges for cocoa “deflation” in the new fiscal year. The post Hershey pricing hits confectionery volumes as salty snacks respond to cuts appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: United Spirits falls foul of Indian watchdog over flavours
items.summary: India’s food regulator has barred the sale of certain alcoholic drinks made saying the products failed to comply with rules.

items.title: Tyson Foods expects steeper losses in beef as third-quarter volumes slide
items.summary: Tyson Foods is expecting to post a steeper annual loss in beef than was originally anticipated as cattle shortages persist. The post Tyson Foods expects steeper losses in beef as third-quarter volumes slide appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: New US Senate funding bill includes month delay to hemp rules
items.summary: US Senators have included a bid to delay the introduction of rules on sales of hemp THC drinks in a new spending bill.

items.title: Shoppers are buying less meat, data shows
items.summary: Customers purchased fewer pounds of fresh and processed proteins, including beef, bacon and lamb, in June as prices continued to rise.

items.title: Why cereal box toys are making a comeback
items.summary: Companies like WK Kellogg are looking to tap into the nostalgia that millennial and Gen X parents feel for the childhood ritual of scooping out the tiny treasures.

items.title: Beiersdorf expects decline in revenue despite recovery plan
items.summary: Persistently weak consumer confidence continues to plague the German beauty company Beiersdorf. The multinational now even expects a slight decline in revenue for the full fiscal year.

items.summary: The deal brings the cheesemaker into the deli section and reflects its ambitions to grow in snacks and mealtime occasions.

items.title: Uber Eats Expands US Footprint With Regional Grocery Partners
items.summary: Uber Technologies has expanded its national grocery footprint in the US through new delivery partnerships with several regional supermarket chains.

items.title: Spinneys Expands Stake In Saudi Arabian Subsidiary To 70%
items.summary: Dubai-based premium fresh food retailer Spinneys has agreed to acquire an additional 20% stake in its Saudi Arabian subsidiary, Spinneys KSA.

items.title: Nivea Maker Beiersdorf Cuts Guidance For 2026, Citing Difficult Market
items.summary: Beiersdorf has trimmed its full-year guidance, citing a difficult market environment and a slower-than-expected recovery at Nivea.

items.title: Groupe Casino Sees Growth In H1 Profitability As Restructuring Takes Hold
items.summary: Groupe Casino saw improvement in profitability in the first half of FY 2026, preliminary, unaudited financial estimates showed.
